 p=f'docs/reference/{name}.md';c=f'docs/reviews/evidence/{name}.json';o=outcome or block()
 raw=f'# Independent proposal\nPreapproval-Feasibility: REQUIRED\nPreapproval-Feasibility-Companion: {c}\n'.encode()

def call(root,p,target=None):
 a=[sys.executable,'-B',str(R/'governance/compat/run_preapproval_feasibility_gate.py'),'--repo-root',str(root),'--proposal',p,'--approval-target',target or p,'--json'];s=subprocess.run(a,cwd=R,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8');return s.returncode,json.loads(s.stdout)

 a=[sys.executable,'-B',str(R/'governance/compat/check_preapproval_feasibility.py'),'--repo-root',str(root),'--base','HEAD','--head','HEAD','--enforce','--json'];s=subprocess.run(a,cwd=R,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8');return s.returncode,json.loads(s.stdout)
